---
title: "From LLMs to Agents"
subtitle: "What the model is, how it is built, and how it begins to act"
---

This site supports a 45-minute conceptual talk for PhD economists,
prepared as background for a later, more applied Claude Code workshop. It
is co-produced with Claude Code under human review: Claude Code drafts and
runs deterministic checks; a human reviewer approves substantive choices,
final wording, and every commit.

::: {.callout-important}
## This is a vertical slice

This site currently contains **one** complete learning module and **three**
of the eventual talk's slides — enough to prove that the website, the
deck, and the browser-based interactive all work together, offline, from
one set of sources. It is not the finished course. The remaining modules,
the full 45-minute deck, and the curated resource library are planned but
not yet built.
:::

## How the two products relate

The eventual live talk will be a carefully selected ~45-minute path through
the material. This website is — and is intended to remain — the fuller,
standalone learning resource: someone who never attends the talk should be
able to learn the material from the site alone, with deeper mathematics,
worked examples, and an interactive laboratory that the live talk only has
time to demonstrate briefly.

## Available now

- [**Softmax, sampling, and temperature**](learn/softmax-sampling.qmd) — a
  complete, standalone learning module, including a live softmax-and-
  sampling laboratory and a no-JavaScript fallback.
- [**Slides**](slides/llms-to-agents.qmd) — the three built slides:
  logits and softmax, training and maximum likelihood, and sampling and
  temperature.
- [**Resources**](resources.qmd) — the sources used in this slice,
  annotated.

## Sources

Every substantive factual claim on this site carries a claim ID that
resolves in `sources/claims.csv`, described in prose in
`sources/source-map.md`. Both files are checked automatically against the
rendered pages.
